Another victim of the shooting died while being transported to the hospital. […]
title: Nine people killed and 25 injured in school shooting in British Columbia

description: The FBI’s Evidence Response Team, in conjunction with the Pima County Sheriff’s Department, is conducting a “court-authorized search” of a residence in Rio Rico, Arizona, on Tuesday night as part of the investigation of the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, the mother of broadcast journalist Savannah Guthrie. title: FBI does ‘court-authorized search’ in Rio Rico, Arizona, for Nancy Guthrie case

title: House fails to extend ban on Trump tariff repeal votes in major blow to Johnson
